# ViraStack AI (full)

> `@virastack/ai` v2 installs disciplined agent rules into a React project. Framework-aware (Next.js vs TanStack Start). Rules are written in Claude Code and Cursor native formats. Not a chat UI library.

## Install

```bash
npx @virastack/ai init
```

Product: https://virastack.com/ai; Docs: https://virastack.com/ai/docs; Index: https://virastack.com/ai/llms.txt; Repo: https://github.com/virastack/ai

## Commands

| Command | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `init` | Install the rules, or update an existing install |
| `remove` | Remove every managed file, the `AGENTS.md` block and the `CLAUDE.md` import. Changed files are kept unless confirmed or `--force` |

## Options

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--agent <list>` | `claude`, `cursor` (comma separated) or `none`. Default `claude,cursor`. Saved in `.virastack/ai.json` |
| `--framework nextjs\|tanstack` | Force framework instead of detecting from `package.json` |
| `--force`, `-f` | Also overwrite (or, with `remove`, delete) managed files you changed |
| `--dry-run` | Print the plan without writing anything |
| `--yes`, `-y` | Answer every question with its default (never overwrite) |
| `--tr` | Turkish CLI output |

## What gets written

| Path | When | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `.claude/rules/virastack/*.md` | `--agent claude` | Claude Code rules, loaded by file path |
| `CLAUDE.md` | `--agent claude` | Gets an `@AGENTS.md` import line if missing |
| `.cursor/rules/virastack/*.mdc` | `--agent cursor` | Cursor rules, loaded by file path |
| `.agents/rules/virastack/*.md` | `--agent none` | Plain Markdown rules for any agent |
| `AGENTS.md` | always | Managed `virastack-ai` block: persona, commands, rule map |
| `.virastack/ai.json` | always | Manifest of installed files with hashes. Commit it |

Content outside the managed `AGENTS.md` block is never touched.

## Rules

| Rule | Loaded for |
| --- | --- |
| `core` | Always: workflow, naming, exports, errors |
| `architecture` | Always: folder tree, feature boundaries, imports |
| `react` | `src/**/*.tsx`, hooks |
| `typescript` | `src/**/*.{ts,tsx}` |
| `ui` | `src/components/**`, feature components |
| `forms` | `*Form*.tsx`, `schemas/` |
| `api` | `src/lib/api.ts`, feature `api/` |
| `server-state` | feature `api/` and `hooks/`, `src/providers/`, `src/lib/query-client.ts` |
| `client-state` | `stores/` |
| `i18n` | `messages/`, `src/i18n/`, components (only with `next-intl` or Paraglide) |
| `performance` | routes and components |
| `testing` | `*.test.{ts,tsx}`, `src/test/` |
| `nextjs` | `src/app/**`, `src/proxy.ts`, `next.config.ts` (Next.js only) |
| `tanstack-start` | `src/routes/**`, `src/router.tsx`, `src/start.ts` (TanStack Start only) |

## Supported tools

- Native rules: Claude Code, Cursor
- Read the `AGENTS.md` map: Codex, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, Zed and other tools that read `AGENTS.md`
- Gemini CLI: add `{ "context": { "fileName": ["AGENTS.md", "GEMINI.md"] } }` to `.gemini/settings.json`
- Aider: add `read: AGENTS.md` to `.aider.conf.yml`

## Upgrading from v1

Run `npx @virastack/ai@latest init`. Rule files and `docs/` written by v1.x are removed if never edited. Edited ones are kept and listed. Guide: https://virastack.com/ai/docs/upgrade

## Relationship to Start

`npx virastack@latest` scaffolds install ViraStack AI automatically and ask which AI tools you use. Inside an existing repo, run `npx @virastack/ai init`.
